title: Transmission line to take 'days' to fix, forcing closure of Eyre Peninsula schools
paragraphs: More than 20,000 properties lost power on South Australia's Eyre Peninsula after a significant storm cell knocked over transmission towers in the region.
It is unclear when power will be restored, and phone services have also been impacted.
SA Premier Peter Malinauskas says the government has instructed Australian Energy Market Operator to seek spare generation.
